question: Hello! In the final episode of the Loss Arc, the direction where Emilia brings her hand toward her mouth while letting out wordless sobs after hearing Subaru introduce himself was far too precious! Did you originally have this direction in mind, or was it something the production staff came up with through their collective wisdom?
answer:
If you read the relevant part of Arc 6 and it's written there, then I came up with it. If it isn't written there, then the anime staff came up with it. It's that simple. (laughs)

I don't think I was writing it while thinking through specific staging like, “Emilia becomes overwhelmed with emotion here, then covers her mouth with her hand...” I believe I simply wrote it in an emotional way, and then, when bringing the feeling they picked up from that writing into the anime, Director Shinohara and all the other staff members involved worked out that this would be the right way to portray it.

So, if you felt that scene was particularly good, then it was entirely thanks to the contributions and efforts of the anime staff—all of the anime staff.
